name: Init
description: What init lays down to start a reference line from.

scenarios.title: The first run lays down an empty glossary
scenarios.then: an empty glossary specification is written at the configured root

scenarios.title: A second run leaves what is there alone
given: a directory init has already run in
scenarios.then: the existing specification is reported as already there

scenarios.title: A configured root is created however deep it is
given: a .sumi.json naming a root two levels down
scenarios.then: every directory on the way to that root is created
